statements.status_notes: CVE-2023-45931 reports a NULL pointer dereference in check_xshm() in Mesa's GLX client code (src/glx/drisw_glx.c): when the X connection is in an error state, xcb_query_extension_reply() returns NULL for the MIT-SHM query and the result is dereferenced without a check (https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/mesa/mesa/-/issues/9859). The CVE record is tagged disputed because no scenario has been demonstrated in which it is a vulnerability (https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2023-45931), but it does not say who disputed it, and the upstream issue is still open with no response from the Mesa developers, so there is no upstream ruling to rely on. The published mesa package ships Mesa's GLX client library as libGLX_mesa.so.0 in libglx-mesa0, built from Mesa 25.0.7 with the Debian 25.0.7-2+deb13u1 changes. The unchecked dereference is still present in Mesa 25.0.7. Debian tracks it as unimportant and unfixed (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2023-45931). Pending: a ruling or fix from Mesa on issue 9859.
